# AntiSpam

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** AntiSpam

## What it does

Remove spam from chat

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/AntiSpam.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Wurst — AntiSpam](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/AntiSpamHack.java)

Blocks chat spam by adding a counter to repeated messages.

Basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).

### [RusherHack — AntiSpam](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/AntiSpam.html)

Remove spam from chat

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/AntiSpam.html).

### [Future — AntiSpam](https://www.futureclient.net/#features)

Block messages from showing in chat that match the regex filters.

Basis: [publisher description](https://www.futureclient.net/#features).
